name: space-booking-system
description: Root workspace: member PWA + admin console + shared package + backend API

scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,member,console -c blue,green,magenta "cd backend && npm start" "npm run dev --workspace @church/member" "npm run dev --workspace @church/console"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @church/member && npm run build --workspace @church/console
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @church/member && npm run lint --workspace @church/console
